Our Mission & Technology

About TECHTIS

The world's fastest, 100% private client-side document & utility suite • 60 professional online tools with zero cloud uploads.

Sub-100ms Speed

No upload waiting times or remote server queues. Operations run directly inside your computer or phone RAM using WebAssembly.

Radical Privacy

Your files never touch external servers or cloud databases. Personal contracts, medical records, and ID scans remain on your device.

100% Free Forever

No hidden paywalls, artificial page limits, or forced registration. All 60 tools are unlimited and accessible worldwide.

Why We Built TECHTIS

Every day, millions of students, legal professionals, accountants, engineers, and everyday users need to perform essential document tasks: fill out a scanned government form, merge financial statements, crop a passport photo, convert images, or compress a PDF for an application portal.

Historically, online document converters have operated on expensive, insecure cloud architectures: you upload your confidential documents to unknown commercial servers, wait in processing queues, and download a copy, hoping your sensitive data is genuinely deleted.

TECHTIS (techtis.in) changes that paradigm forever. Modern browsers are astonishingly powerful computing engines. By harnessing client-side WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, and modern Web Workers, TECHTIS delivers 60 professional-grade document, image, developer, and CSS utilities that execute entirely in your browser memory.

The Client-Side Technology Stack

Our architecture relies exclusively on modern browser standards and high-performance WebAssembly engines:

  • PDF Parsing & Composition: In-browser pdf-lib and PDF.js for vector stream reconstruction, font embedding, encryption, and direct visual rendering without server overhead.
  • High-DPI Canvas Resampling: Hardware-accelerated HTML5 Canvas with bicubic scaling algorithms for sub-pixel image cropping, passport photo tiling, and real-time color space transformations.
  • Sandboxed Web Workers: Long-running tasks execute in asynchronous background threads, ensuring the user interface remains completely responsive at 60 FPS even when handling multi-hundred-page files.
  • Global Edge Delivery: Static assets are precompiled and distributed globally via Cloudflare Edge network with HTTP/3 and Brotli compression, providing sub-50ms Time-to-First-Byte worldwide.
